summary: LSB Industries filed an 8-K (Item 8.01) disclosing that it will immediately begin the previously announced turnaround at its Pryor, Oklahoma facility, originally scheduled for July 2026. The change in timing is not expected to affect duration or cost estimates. No financial terms, price per share, premium, or board recommendation are provided. This is an operational update, not a special situation event. The filing is a routine current report regarding a plant maintenance schedule adjustment.
